CIRCLEFORNIA

CALIFORNIA EQUIVALENT FINDER
LINKED UNLINKED FIELD NIGHT
METHOD
circlefornia measures any point on earth against california: population 39.4M, product $4.10T (2024, nominal).

population: gridded population of the world v4 (CIESIN / NASA SEDAC), 15 arc-minute cells, land-fraction corrected, renormalized per country to world bank 2024 totals — ~96,000 mass points. product per cell = population × national GDP per capita (downscaled, not measured). city names are geonames, labels only. circles are true geodesic circles — the projection makes them ovals.

linked — both circles grow from one point. the ring between them is the gap between where people are and where product is.
unlinked — assemble california from two places. one circle gathers only people, the other only product. drag either pin.
field — every point on earth colored by the ratio of its two radii. cyan: product arrives first. magenta: people arrive first. pale points are californias.
